properties.name: delete_node's node_type is optional: the id's prefix stands as the caller's stated type, and the delete proceeds only when the node's type matches it
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-19 (field limitation 23, VS Code --call run on 0.87.0)
properties.statement: delete_node accepts an id without node_type. It then deletes only when exactly one type holds the id AND that type is the one the id's prefix names by convention (req: → Requirement, dec: → Decision …). Otherwise it refuses and deletes nothing, naming what the id holds: a prefix with no conventional type, a holder whose type differs from the prefix's, or an id held by two types. A passed node_type behaves exactly as today. This reopens ruling #3b (2026-09-06) for delete_node only.
